context: Tests the trickiest rubric distinction in the skill: that two images from the same vendor (Chainguard) can land in different tiers based on the source registry path. cgr.dev/chainguard/* is free; cgr.dev/chainguard-private/* is commercial. Collapsing them into a single 'Chainguard' verdict is the most plausible failure mode of an unprimed model.

checklist.name: Paid image classified as commercial
checklist.description: image-graph classifies cgr.dev/chainguard-private/postgres:16 as tier=commercial (NOT free).

checklist.name: Tiers not collapsed to vendor verdict
checklist.description: Report does NOT lump both into a single 'Chainguard' verdict. The two images appear in different tier rows in image-graph.md and have different tier values in image-graph.json.

checklist.name: Cites the source-registry distinction
checklist.description: Report's explanation cites that the registry path (chainguard/* vs chainguard-private/*) is the tie-breaker, not the vendor name. Verbatim or clearly equivalent.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: Report does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers.
